trello.name: Fix staging deploy by updating CI registry token
trello.desc: Owner: Ade. The staging deploy job has been failing since this morning because it cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token (missed during yesterday's token rotation). Steps: regenerate the registry token, update the CI secret with the new token, and re-run the deploy job. Deadline: within one hour. Acceptance criteria: staging deploy job goes green and developers can test again.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena
trello.desc: Owner: Ade. Kim promised Meridian an updated proposal with the new pricing by end of day today. The final numbers are in the spreadsheet. Steps: drop the final numbers from the spreadsheet into the proposal doc and send the updated proposal to Meridian's procurement contact Lena (email available from the kickoff thread). Deadline: end of day today. Acceptance criteria: updated proposal doc with new pricing is sent to Lena.
